property: Formal revision of the interface between data terminal/data processing terminal equipment and data communication equipment.

date_or_range.notes: The NBS standards survey records RS-232 May 1960 and RS-232-A October 1963; the TIA historical listing identifies RS-232 as the preceding version.

sources.notes: Government standards survey; original 1960 text still needs acquisition for field-level comparison.

sources.supports: RS-232-A publication date and revised relationship to May 1960 RS-232
sources.notes: Commercial standards-store metadata, not a substitute for the complete historical standard text.

negative_claims: This edge does not claim that every signal, connector rule, voltage limit, or pin assignment commonly associated with later RS-232-C already existed unchanged in the May 1960 edition.
open_questions: Acquire the complete May 1960 RS-232 text.
Acquire the complete October 1963 RS-232-A text.
Produce a circuit-by-circuit, electrical and connector diff.
notes: Formal revision edge chosen as a reference example because it is stronger than a retrospective influence claim.
